_comment: Activity hero photos. npm run images:activities downloads each one into public/images/activities/<slug>.jpg (resized to 2400px) and writes the credit to credits.json. Leave an activity out to fall back to a park photo. NPS photos are public domain; Unsplash photos are free under the Unsplash License.
